newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Petsec appoints U.S. operations head.
newsitem.headline: Petsec appoints U.S. operations head.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Petsec Energy Ltd said on Tuesday it has appointed an experienced oil industry executive as president and chief operating officer of its U.S. operating subsidiary Petsec Energy Inc.
Petsec said Alan Stevens would be responsible for day-to-day operations and management in the United States and would report to managing director Terry Fern.
Stevens was previously senior vice president in charge of worldwide exploration at Occidental Oil and Gas Corp.
Fern said Petsec had decided to make the appointment because of the expansion of its operations.
The company expected to double production in calendar 1997 on the previous year, and would drill 16 wells in its sole arena of operations, the Gulf of Mexico, he said.
Petsec shares were five cents firmer at A$6.10 at 12.45 p.m. (0245 GMT).
